enunciado: Use a stack of strings to decide whether each expression has its ( ) [ ] { } symbols properly balanced: "{a[(b+c)*d]}", "(a+b]", "((x)", "x+y)" and "[{()()}]".
objetivos: Apply a stack to a real compiler problem
Detect the three kinds of error: wrong closer, closer without opener and opener without closer
pistas: On a closer, the top must be its partner; if the stack is empty, it fails.
At the end the stack must be empty.
